title: The lens and cornea focus light on the retina
summary: The lens works with the cornea to focus light on the retina, the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
body: The National Eye Institute says light next passes through the lens, a clear inner part. The lens and the cornea together focus that light on the retina. The institute calls the retina a light-sensitive layer of tissue at the back of the eye. This is the focusing step only. The signals that leave the retina are a different claim.

sources.title: How the Eyes Work
sources.author: National Eye Institute
sources.note: Supports the lens working with the cornea to focus light on the retina.
